unit.why: The division records R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev's habitual Rosh Hashanah chant before the Amidah, giving the full prayer text and noting that its melody was also handed down; no event unfolds, so there is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: Borderline: a custom ('he used to sing') with a quoted prayer text, not a narrative; neighbouring divisions (יב, יד) are separate numbered items.
